CRYPTO 2015; first ePrint 26 September 2014. Charikar angular LSH accelerates the pair search. The source gives heuristic time 0.3366 and space 0.2075 for its Nguyen–Vidick variant. The practical GaussSieve-based HashSieve has a separate conjectured time/space bound 0.3366/0.3366; the smaller-space NV bound should not be attributed to that implementation. This row is the source variant satisfying the baseline-list-space constraint.

A low-memory improvement, rather than a chronological time record after SphereSieve. The source states heuristic time 0.3112 while retaining space 0.2075. The method adapts nearest-neighbor search for binary codes. First ePrint received 31 May 2015; source publication status is preprint. This row is the source variant satisfying the baseline-list-space constraint.
